label: POST-HOC descriptive extension of E155; no independent confirmation
selection: All P/A/B native raw argmax predictions equal gold; no intervention filtering

pattern_labels.0: D fails; removing either R or S fails
pattern_labels.1: D fails; only D+S preserves success
pattern_labels.2: D fails; only D+R preserves success
pattern_labels.3: D fails; D+R and D+S each preserve success
pattern_labels.4: D works; D+R and D+S both fail
pattern_labels.5: D works; only D+S preserves success
pattern_labels.6: D works; only D+R preserves success
pattern_labels.7: D, D+R and D+S all preserve success

bootstrap.aggregation: equal subject macro; pooled counts separately labelled

limits: Whole-network branch removals can alter hidden states and routing. Patterns describe measured success under interventions, not knowledge fractions, semantic algorithms, or training causality. Native-success selection excludes intervention corrections.
